title: Qualification artifact temporary-file hard-link race
summary: CodeRabbit identified that a visible replacement temporary file could gain a hard link after initial validation and before rename.
problem_pattern: A visible temporary inode is validated once and later published after a mutable interval.
failure_mode: A concurrent process can create another hard link so a multiply linked inode is written or published.
root_cause: Initial link-count validation was treated as durable across the write/publication interval.
prevention_rule: Retain descriptor identity across the write and revalidate inode/link state at the publication boundary; add a deterministic race regression.
preflight_checks: revalidate descriptor and directory entry immediately before rename
test a hard link created after initial validation
applicability_notes: Project-specific evidence. Generalized prevention is captured separately in K-GEN-RACE-BOUNDARY-001.
